a plaque rupture is a result of nonlinear resonance of an atherosclerosis plaque caused by the flow.

the rupture is caused by resonance of a plaque, and the rupture can be predicted by the resonance analysis of plaque vibrations.

the development of a new approach to the plaque rupture prediction and the development of a non-invasive plaque rupture detection method based on the resonance of a plaque and its vibration analysis.
the development of a new approach for predicting a plaque rupture and atherosclerrotic plaque rupture mechanism.

the resonance hypothesis is supported by the data obtained by means of FE/FSI modeling.
the wave approach and the hypothesis that a plaque rupture is caused by nonlinear resonance are valid.
the resonance hypothesis is a promising new paradigm for a plaque rupture.
